newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Nord Pacific Q3 net profit drops.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nord Pacific Q3 net profit drops.

text.p: Nord Pacific Ltd said on Thursday its net earnings for the September quarter were US$284,000, a fall of 71 percent from the previous corresponding period.

Nord said contributing to the drop in net earnings were losses of US$22,000 on forward currency exchange contracts and foreign currency transactions in the 1996 third quarter compared with gains of US$846,000 for the same period in 1995.
However, operating earnings for the September quarter increased 15 percent to US$967,000, struck on revenues of US$4.36 million.

Nord said it had achieved a record quarterly production of 1,874 tonnes of copper from its 40 percent owned Girilambone and 50 percent owned Girilambone North copper mines in New South Wales, an increase of 61 percent over the corresponding period in 1995.
